# Ras Mantra Sweets & Bakers By Badrinath

> Authentic Pure Desi Ghee Indian Sweets (Mithai), Eggless Bakery, Celebration Cakes, Savory Snacks, and Luxury Festive Gift Hampers in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh.

## Quick Facts
- **Domain:** https://rasmantra.shop
- **Brand Name:** Ras Mantra Sweets & Bakers By Badrinath
- **Founder / Heritage:** By Badrinath
- **Location:** Ram Naresh Square, Kanchanpur, Deva Road, Matiyari, Chinhat, Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh 226028, India
- **Coordinates:** Latitude 26.8928, Longitude 81.0263
- **Google Maps Location:** https://share.google/oOSkmaEtxCugrYTIi
- **Phone:** +91 63873 10730
- **Operating Hours:** Open daily from 8:00 AM to 11:00 PM (Monday through Sunday)
- **Cuisine & Offerings:** 100% Pure Desi Ghee Indian Mithai, Eggless Bakery & Designer Cakes, Hot Street Food (Samosa, Dhokla, Chaat), South Indian (Masala Dosa), Indo-Chinese snacks, and custom Gift Hampers for Weddings and Festivals.
- **Rating:** 4.8 / 5.0 on Google (420+ Reviews)

## Core Offerings & Specialties
- **Pure Desi Ghee Mithai:**
  - Royal Kaju Katli (Goan cashews with silver vark)
  - Shahi Motichoor Laddu (saffron pearls fried in pure ghee)
  - Desi Ghee Gulab Jamun & Khoya Gujiya
  - Besan Laddus & Kaju Pista Rolls
- **Bengali Specials:**
  - Kolkata Sponge Rasgulla (fresh cow milk chhena)
  - Kesar Pista Rasmalai
  - Shahi Sandesh & Kheer Kadam
- **Artisanal Bakery & Celebration Cakes:**
  - 100% Eggless Dutch Truffle Chocolate Cake
  - Exotic Fresh Fruit Gateau
  - Bakery Butter Pista Cookies & Red Velvet Pastries
- **Savory Snacks & Street Food:**
  - Grilled Paneer Tikka Sandwiches
  - Butter Masala Dosas
  - Punjabi Samosa & Gujarati Khaman Dhokla
  - Crispy Fried Paneer Momos
- **Festive & Corporate Gifting:**
  - Royal Heritage Festive Velvet Hampers
  - Wedding Bhiksha Boxes & Dry Fruit Trays
  - Bulk orders & customized corporate packaging
